flags.message: The event resolved on 2026-10-02 (single-Justice denial) and both predictions were created on 2026-10-02 at about 21:30Z from a 2026-10-01 snapshot, so the denial was plausibly public when the forward cells ran. Neither retrieval log nor either reasoning document shows the disposition being retrieved (case-specific CourtListener lookups returned nothing; the one corpus priors query listed rows that exclude 26A447), so both cells are graded forward and clean. Not a mis-provisioned decided case, but the window between provisioning and resolution on fast interim applications is a day or less; outcome.json carries no time of day, so the forward guarantee for such cells rests on the logs rather than on timestamps.
